Ai PHOENIX JOURNAL EXPRESS c-.,, H 8/2/90 HATONN May the light shine ever around and about you as you walk through the darkness created for your path. Hatonn present to com- mune and offer insight to current happenings. I ask indulgence to the Journal and Express readers for there is so much to be handled and time and resources limited as to quantity of information we can disperse. Please know we are do- ing all humanly possible to bring forth responses to your queries. WHAT IS IN THE NEWS THIS DAY We had begun on a full disserta- tion as to why the probabilities of war occurring in Iraq and Kuwait was imminent. We were unable to finish in time for dispersement prior to the invasion by Iraq. In a minute we will look at what is re- ally going on but first I must make a few statements to you precious ones who write to us. I must ask indulgence and patience in per- sonal response for we are abso- lutely smothered in piles of work. We have another concurrent situ- ation which is time consuming and energy debilitating. As in- vestigations proceed regarding the S&L, RTC and this property, Dharma has moved into a fast to precipitate attention to the mat- ter--which, although ones are dili- gent in timely dispersement of the information to Senators, central participants, etc., it is not quick enough to avoid impact on my scribe. The attorneys for our cause have succumbed to the pres- sure and have asked court relief from the case for the ties of cor- ruption go far beyond the gover- nor of the State of California, Representatives to Congress and all the way to the top of the RTC, etc. The case will simply have to be utilized as a national example and I would ask all of you readers to unite in writing to every public place you can think of in our be- half. If you call or write to Amer- ica West, someone will give you information regarding the case so that you work in an informed manner---THIS situation is one which will end up touching all of you for the INTENT is to take and control ALL property--YOURS MAY WELL BE NEXT! The tabloids are excellent resources for coverage for those are the most read papers--it is only of value to major press as human in- terest but will give us a forum. It might seem little to do, but what of the “mountain springing forth from the mole-hill?” We can maintain her in some measure of health safety through August, but the physical form may well shut down prior to that--it is not weight loss which impacts, it is the toxins released which damage, irre- versibly, the organs. Therefore, I ask your speedy action for she is already over two weeks without food intake. Herein is a place whereby you can participate most nobly--for those of you who have asked “what can I do?” I further request that this Express be gotten out immediately. Just as example of the corrupt ju- diciary system: The “rules” gave these ones two weeks to rebut and object to the “relief” of attorneys and that is being honored in Fresno (some distance away but central to the district). In the Lo- cal Bakersfield system--relief was granted ex parte in less than three days with no allowance for re- sponse from the defendants. Worse, this was to the panel of judges who would decide whether or not to over-rule the municipal court judge, Brent, and allow dwelling availability. I plead with you ones to take notice for you will all end up victim of this mas- sive monster sweeping your land. Very few of these incidents even show up in court, the public is so blind and the lie and collusion so massive--most just turn and walk away thinking there is no recourse. Ones who have been railroaded, especially in California, come forth and unite--it is the only way you can stand against this steam- roller. I further ask that you re- frain from doing what one “friend” has done and simply remark that, “I don’t hate any help with my property and Dharma can stand to lose a few pounds!” Fortunately, this one is distant but all of you ones must be prepared for that type of self-centered meanness. 1 VOL. III #2
THIS IS GOD’S PROPERTY AND WE NEED TO KNOW WHO STANDS WITH GOD AND COUNTRY--IT HAS NOTHING TO DO WITH DHARMA AND OBERLI AND I PLEAD WITH YOU TO SEE AS MUCH. Back to the current events. You can see it unfolding before your eyes if you take the information given to this point and consider what is happening. There HAS to be a war to pull out of the slump and better arrange for the control of the masses. Whoever controls the energy re- source, controls the world’s “wheels”. Please note the increase in oil prices instantly! Who bene- fits from that? Of course! It fur- ther gives cause to inflate to out of sight prices and bring an oil short- age like you haven’t dreamed of. Plus, you have to have a war to put your masses back to work in the good old industrial U.S.A. Note that a request has been pressed forth for American intervention with military might. Iraq has atomic war-heads but it is proba- ble that they will not yet be uti- lized for a “war” is not the point at this time--it is to bring Kuwait back into line with oil supply. Russia wants it under control the same as the U.S. and will work most closely with the U.S. to or- chestrate the madness. Beloved ones, this could be THE one which can set it all off--pay atten- tion. The conspirators are still perfecting the plan but you are near indeed. There is a little “annual” meeting in Colorado this day, for your President and one which “he couldn’t cancel even in this crisis”. It is with the top leaders who reg- ularly meet from the Bilderberg- ers, Trilats, CFR, etc., just as they did the week of the Economic Summit” in Houston--Colorado is WHERE THEY HAVE THE MEETING PLACEMENT’. Further, please note that no sanc- tions were made against Red China and yet before the smoke clears from the first gunshot in Kuwait--the sanctions are in place and operable. That means, dear ones, that they were already drawn and waiting--your government not only knew of the invasion--but planned it right alongside the other Cartel Planners and now, in Colorado, they will make decisions as to subsequent moves to accom- plish whatever they decide comes next. The thrust is to pull the entire Arab nations group into the alter- cation and then, do you actually believe Israel will simply sit on their dime? And what of Iran? Iran is already disadvantaged by the massive earthquake--also man created--and the ability to trounce her is obvious. The war can give excuse to totally annihilate Pales- tine--especially the West Bank. Can it actually happen? Very well may, before you can even receive of this document. LAST ATLAS ROCKET1 SATELLITE LAUNCH I may not tell you what is really in- tended by that flight--I want to keep my people alive, not make sitting ducks of them. I will say, however, that even if it is exactly what the government claims it to be, it has implications which you must not overlook. 1). If, in fact, it is a “locating” com- puter device which can guide mili- tary units, and locate units to the nearest few feet of geographical location---WHY? If you are re- ducing your armies and closing many of your bases and the war is over--WHY? WHY? AND WHY? 2). Why wouldn’t the Russians just take it out? Why would they--they are your joint allies in this maneu- ver, and, they can utilize the satel- lite as well as you can, or better. It 2 VOL. III #2 is certainly no threat to them--it is an asset at your expense. 3). It should prove to you that all of the other manipulations are set and confirmed--at some point you the public will see the truth of these projections. 4). The satellite is not spying on Russia--its path is over the Middle East. WHY? You think you don’t have suffi- cient technology? Brothers of the blind tribes--one of your “very own” attorneys is involved with a government lawsuit regarding a “beam system” that could cut through layers of hardened steel in mere seconds--over five years ago. Wake up and smell the toast burning before it is your “feet”. THE ZIONIST “PROTOCOLS” George met with a business part- ner yesterday who is furious, fist pounding angry and also a tad ag- gravated that George is publishing this material. He says that the protocols were written by the Rus- sian Czar to get rid of the Jews. Oops! This man is a Jew! Is he a Zionist Jew? Who cares! Only he need know and the innocent are always the last to know so proba- bly not. I speak not against the Jews of Abraham--I speak of the Zionists who are not actually Jews at all but only have usurped the wondrous race to destroy it. He further stated that we have “everyone” against us. So be it. No, we do not have everyone against us, for if the people awaken, we have the masses with us and it will be the masses who will decide in the end. We, further, have God and the Hosts of Heaven in service unto that God, with us and that will be sufficient unto our needs--for it shall be the truth of the WORD which shall inspire mankind into action. YOU THE PEOPLE CAN CONTROL YOUR DES- TINY--BUT TO DO SO, YOU
MUST KNOW HOW IT IS AND ACT--NOT IRRATIONALLY BUT WITH INTENDED PURPOSE. THE “MEEK” SHALL INHERIT THE EARTH AND DON’T LOSE SIGHT OF IT. ONE EXAMPLE IS WORTH A VOLUME OF WORDS--LET US EXAMPLE THIS SIMPLE S&L CORRUP- TION AND THIS PROPERTY IN THE WORLD PRESS AND IT BECOMES HARDER TO HIDE THE TRUTH. THIS IS BUT AN EXAMPLE AND THERE ARE THOUSANDS IN THE SAME CIRCUMSTANCE TO JOIN RANKS IN THE FORTHRIGHT STAND AGAINST THE SYSTEM. NEVER IN VIOLENCE--IN THE SHIELD OF TRUTH! HOWEVER, IF YOU DO NOT MOVE TO SUPPORT EACH OTHER YOU MAY EXPECI- TO BE SWEPT AWAY IN THE EVER RISING TIDE OF CON- TROL. TAKES Your government is in the midst of budget dancing. Please note that there is promise of reduction of employees in every major aerospace industry and layoffs and cutbacks in every portion of your nation. Your trade is off, your debt skyrockets and compounds and yet, no consideration is given to a reduction in the people’s ability to pay taxes at all. I speak not of tax revolt--I speak of taxes in general--if the people are in de- pression and out of work--there are no taxes. This, too, is why you must have a war--to put workers back to work on defense spending industry. Therefore the rush will be on to set it up so a Constitu- tional Convention will be manda- tory and the clamps put to you ones. It is indeed serious! ATOMIC WAR AND SHELTERS I am most grateful to a reader who has written the following: “My next door neighbors are leaders in the anti-nuclear movement here in Alaska. . . . It is reported that all the ma- jor U.S. cities (and possibly all cities with 10,000 or more citi- zens) have a Soviet nuclear bomb of 20 megatons aimed at them. A 20 megaton bomb will blast a crater 3/4 of a mile wide and SO0 ft. deep. With- out considering that air will be sucked out of shelters within a radius of 20 miles from epi- center, how is it possible to survive a 20 megaton within the crater in a shelter under 10 ft of dirt? Hatonn says that everyone will survive in a shelter under 10 ft. of ground but reports on a 20 megaton bomb say that every- one within a 50 mile radius will die. Moreover all the plants in a much larger radius (also de- pending on winds) will be con- taminated for an unknown pe- riod of time (maybe decades) and pests will infiltrate the lands and bring disease and death to walking survivors even hundreds of miles away. This is why nuclear activists don’t believe a nuclear war is survivable and why they be- lieve fallout shelters are merely a placebo, therefore a lie. I personally question coming out of a shelter following a nu- clear attack and finding all plants inedible and swarms of hungry disease infested pests racing towards me. George, I hate to see powerful allies like our nuclear activist friends turned off with in- formation that’s not compati- ble with proven facts (i.e. what a 20 megaton bomb will do). The question becomes “if I can’t believe this, how can I believe anything else I read in i VOL. III #2 the Journals?” I personally check my truth meter and accept that what feels right. Most of what I read in the Journals feels right to me or I wouldn’t continue reading and supporting them. When I’m questioned on some points like the nuclear survival issue I simply don’t have a rea- sonable response. Maybe only humane little bombs will be used and 10 feet of dirt and one week in a shelter will be more than adequate for sur- vival, I don’t know. Will you please ask if this question will be answered in the Express so the man I pose the question for will be answered. Sin- cerely, DBA Yes sir, delighted to respond. What would the activists have you do? Would they perhaps prove from whence this “proven” infor- mation comes? Could it be an- other great lie in cover-up to keep you blatantly helpless? JUST WHAT DO THEY PROPOSE DOING ABOUT IT? Further, I suggest everyone re- read the material. I did not say that everyone “would” survive--I did say “everyone could survive” in a good sturdy shelter with only 10 feet of dirt--less if the diet is com- pressed. This is for several reasons but I shall give you one to chew on. To inflict the kind of damage of which you speak you would have to have a “GROUND DETONATION” which is most highly non-probable and totally impractical on the part of the enemy. An air detonation does more damage to ,the most people--if unprotected in shelters- -and that would be the point. Therefore, ybu are not likely to have many, if any, ground detona- tions because that kicks up ra- dioactive dust particles which would blanket your world--and your enemies are not that stupid. Plus, the neutron bomb will be-
come the bomb of choice--this be- cause it kills life but preserves physical buildings, factories, etc. and yet a well built shelter is in- deed safe during the early days of such attack. If the shelter has adequate clo- sures--no air will be sucked out. And, if the detonation is air insti- tuted, it will not dig such a crater-- especially if a neutron bomb. If it is accidentally detonated on the ground you still have only an 800 ft deep hole measuring 3/4 of a mile. Well, couldn’t you just maybe place the shelter outside the radius of the expected detona- tion and hookup by a tunnel sys- tem? Further, even if the facts are absolutely truth regarding the over 10,000 population targets--aren’t these simply good reasons for spreading out and being in a non- targeted area? They can’t hit ev- erything! The point will be to maintain the planet to its best ad- vantage for later use so the plan- ning is careful indeed. As to plants and insects. Yes there would be devastation on the surface in total amounts in some areas--but for instance, if you have underground protected green- houses you will be able to grow even if the ground is contami- nated. ALL ground will NOT be contaminated nor will all ground water but surface water probably will be intentionally contaminated. There are ways to clean up water, my friends; that is just something else they don’t allow you to know. If the nuclear activists spent as much time preparing for the pos- sibility of survival as they do talk- ing about why it can’t be done, you would have shelters and storage. Your enemies depend on you to be distracted and rendered inac- tive. Now, as to pests--if “everything” is killed and the plants gone---where are these “pests” going to come from? You can’t have it both ways! What pests will be left to rush to eat you? I want to point out something else to you movie believers. Irradi- ation mutation does not breed gi- ant species in great masses. Radi- ation kills and mutates to stunted species. Further, if the insects are dying of radiation poison, they won’t be very hungry for radiation sickness is very appetite killing in its own right. Part of the problem you will face is that there will be no insects and scavengers to help tend the dead and dying and the diseases which have grown resis- tant to your modern medical treatments and radiation therapy will feed upon the dead flesh without method of disposal of natural manner. You will pray for the insects and vultures to come. The government is getting ready to give you a real fuel shortage and therefore perhaps you ones can practice staying home and dig- ging or walking. You need the shelters and storage to survive your own government plans read- ied for you. Is nuclear “stuff’ not bad? Of course it is bad--just don’t confuse “bad” in general with inability to survive a nuclear attack if you are prepared. I can, however, point out that you may be already too late to get a superb system into operation for your wealth has flowed into destruction and earn- ing money on money and not pro- duction--anyway, you are all caught short. Your surpluses have gone to your own enemies for their survival systems--they also have shelters--you do not! You ones further ask, “What is Dharma doing about shelters etc.” At this point, nothing, for these one’s thrust is to get the word out with as many instructions along with truth as possible, to the pub- lic. They have no resources with which to place a shelter and the property is in litigation whereby they cannot dig on the land if they had the resources. They just con- 4 VOL. III #2 tinue to do their job to the best of their ability and if they perish, so be it, is the conclusion they have reached. They spend money on postage--not grain and printing, not fuel--they have exhausted all resources to bring forth the WORD. I am reminded: “NO GREATER LOVE HATH ANY MAN THAN TO LAY DOWN HIS LIFE FOR HIS FRIEND.” That, dear ones, is the level of dedication of my beloved Phoenix central “troops”. Do they “want” to get killed? Foolish question--do you? And yet it is the attitude of helplessness that keeps you in non-contribution except to tell us “why our’s won’t work” without solution of any manner. Don’t tell us what won’t work--just stand aside and you will see that with God, ALL is possible and most surely will work. Pitch in contribution of service, or what- ever, and in unity you can change the end of the world from the “end” to the “new beginning”--it is Satan who immobilizes you by such projections of hopelessness. If ones would stop being “activists” and become “actors” in reason and purpose without the violence which only ends you in jail, we could get our work done very quickly. You are kept fragmented in purposeful distraction in order that you not unite as a total citi- zenry. You the people keep sending criminals into your Congress. You send men, even of good intent, in general, who have not so much as “read” the Consti- tution. You send victims of the lie into the nest of the liars and salute them when they remove each of your freedoms in order to stir around in some special interest facet of society---the special inter- est group the government and the Global Planners 2000 are out to get--IS YOU THE PEOPLE! It is all but finished! It will be exactly as you allow of it to be.
CORPORATIONS Another major item is Corpora- tions. Herein I shall repeat some things and please hear me. I say everyone can use a “retirement” or “family” corporation. Yes, that does not mean that everyone will have one--there are thousands and thousands who do not need such in reality of practice for the assets may not be enough to merit the investment of time and money. However, if your assets will be greater than the cost of the corpo- ration in Nevada which is less than $1,500 to start and minimal to maintain--then it would benefit you in so many ways, from privacy, security, tax avoidance, stopping the in-fighting of greedy offspring and on and on. A corporation never dies, it just gets a new presi- dent. No bank accounts are held in probate, etc. I simply cannot take the time to give a full lecture on “how to”, I can only basically tell you what is available and you ones must do some of your own homework--the people on my staff are busy some 20 hours a day. We will continually try to make avail- able information and perhaps we can begin to have regional meet- ings, such as Freedom ‘90 just past, and allow these subjects coverage with handout materials to cut expenses and travel. We also have to remember that it is most expensive to even remain in operation, much less cover all these necessary facets. Please bear with us until we can better serve you. I would like to herein share some insight and I shall simply quote from one in the real estate busi- ness for years and years and uti- lizes dozens of corporations per- sonally. His input is valuable for consideration and perhaps states the situation more clearly than can I. He speaks of close “family friends” sharing your business, etc., as well as friends and that is ex- cellent--also, if incorporated. But suppose you have no willing mem- bers and the estate is messed up and, and, and---: IF YOU CAN’T PLAN YOUR OWN DEMISE, THEN PLAN TO BE IM- MORTAL. Jack Miller In lieu of finding that trusted friend with whom to entrust the management of your fi- nancial affairs, consider an operating corporation as an al- ternative. Think for a moment of how a corporation really operates. Shareholders choose Directors (so you can pick a group of savvy people to make the broad policy de- cisions and to develop long term strategies for the de- ployment and investment of your assets). Directors hire Officers. Thus, the actual implementation of these poli- cies will be taken care of in your absence. As the principal stockholder, you can control the Board with your vote, and thus the selection of Officers too. Once you’re satisfied, you can leave your proxy with an agent who will oversee your interests. This not only pro- vides for future continuity of income for yourself and your heirs/or favorite charities. It also relieves you of any day-to- day management chores you don’t like TODAY. It’s not as hard as you think. INCORPORATE! I recently had a chance to visit one of the retail outlets owned by Hughes Property Manage- ment, Inc. That’s a company started by Howard Hughes. Although he died in March, 1976, his company lives on, earning tremendous profits. Oh, you might know it by its ‘trade name’, ‘THE SANDS’ (Nevada). It is a casino on the strip in Las Vegas. It still em- ploys lots of people, pays taxes, is still growing and competing while it adds to his estate for the benefit of his (apparently millions of) heirs. Because it’s an operating business, it can offer a variety of methods by which heirs can benefit. They can become employees and managers, leasing specialists, casino operators, booking agents, ac- countants, lawyers, financial advisors. They can sit on the Board of Directors and/or serve as Officers with a basket full of fringe benefits. Or they can just be stockholders living off their dividends. It provides great flexibility. Hatonn: Oh, you say, “Well, I’m not Howard Hughes--I just have a little bit of retirement and some property of not much value.” Good--you only need (1) (ONE) person to serve as “everything” im- portant in your Nevada Corpora- tion and the owner of the corpora- tion is never divulged to anyone unless you do it yourself and then they can’t “prove” it. That means you control the stock, the busi- ness, etc., and have an arrange- ment whereby you have a “run my business until I die” constraint if you choose. Basically all those who retire should form a corporation and use the framework it provides for meaningful work, recreation, es- tate planning, a source of dividend income outside the limitations set by depression and early death, etc. That is reason enough to get your- self or your parents incorporated-- in Nevada--even if there are not valid business reasons why this would seem to make sense. But there are. Everything from fringe benefits to pay medical insurance costs, fantastic Defined Benefit Pension Plan tax shelters at their age, incorpohted hobbies, and a sense of real self worth for them and for you. And think a minute-- who would you get for executor of your estate and walk the assets through probate, etc? Is it not your family members usually? 5 VOL. III #2
Then put them on your Board of Directors and set up non-voting stock, etc. There are many ways to handle the details. What guarantees that Nevada will stay flexible and out of the grips of the Cartels? Because it is where the boys of the Cartels set up their business interests--there and off- shore. Further, it probably will fall to the system but you will have perhaps bought a little security and stability in the meanwhile. LETS TALK “PRIVACY” How can you insure maximum pri- vacy, anonymity and protection of your assets? One way to maintain the privacy and anonymity of ownership or control of your assets is to have those assets in a corporation whose ownership is difficult to de- tect. You can increase this privacy by not actually owning the stock of the corporation, while still having as much control as you desire. (John D. Rockefeller once said that the secret of his success was “owning nothing but controlling everything”.) And if anyone should know, it would be David Rockefeller. One way to achieve this control without ownership is the “Endorsed-in-Blank” technique. To understand how this works, you must understand that stock certificates are very much like checks. The registered owner can “endorse” the back of the stock certificate and give or sell that cer- tificate to a third party in much the same way that the recipient of a check can sign it and pass it on to someone else. Usually this en- dorsed certificate is then submit- ted to the corporation’s corporate secretary who issues a new certifi- cate in the new owner’s name. HOWEVER, Therefore it is quite possible to is- sue a stock certificate to a third party who immediately endorses the certificate and hands it to the ultimate owner (or some other third party). This person holds on to the certificate and does not submit it to the corporate secre- tary. In the meantime anyone who examines the share register will see that the original owner is still a shareholder in the corporation. There is added flexibility in the use of the Endorsed in Blank technique as well since the deci- sion as to who the new owner will be can be made at any time by the person in possession of the en- dorsed certificates, depending upon the legal famifications. This technique can work very well with the Warbucks/Red Inc. strat- egy (see PRIVACY IN THE FISHBOWL regarding corpora- tions). This would be where Red Inc.--your home state corporation (and you would need a second corporation in your home state in this instance)--has all its assets en- cumbered by Warbucks--the Nevada-based corporation. By using the Endorsed in Blank tac- tic, you can make it very difficult for anyone to find out who the real owner of Warbucks is...and, if you do things just right, then it doesn’t matter who the real owner is, because it is not reflected as “you”. As a matter of fact, Nevada law can make even the tracking down of a corporation’s share register tedious in the extreme. The regis- ter does not have to be kept in Nevada. The Nevada offices of the corporation must of Further the locations can shift at random with a simple no- tification and if the notification happens to cross investigators in the mail--so be it. This is just one little example of how to utilize the tools. Obviously if you are retired and simply are running hobbies and family busi- ness of personal nature for the benefits under incorporation--you won’t do all this other “stuff”. Remember, these bits of in- formation are going to the most sophisticated of business owners and to the least of the interested public. We cannot cover it all and you must be selective as to that which can be utilized. A NOTE FROM A SUBSCRIBER I especially thank the sender of this following note which I want to comment about. I do not jest, I thank you for this opportunity to emphasize the last statement re- garding information and the Ex- presses as well as the Journals. “S.R.: I fully intended to let my subscription lapse until the last issue arrived. It was the only one that included material that we did not already know. (Vol. II #13). We sure don’t need any more issues where Hatonn has to defend himself and others. I was beginning to think he was a bit paranoid. I’ll try again. P.S. I want to know the news behind the news and what is being planned for us besides the bomb.” I can only repeat that we do the best we can to make a widespread scatter of the,material. I will not tell you unknown information that will get my people killed--they are already under attack, physically, on a constant basis. The point, in addition, is not for me to “think for you”, it is to give you information, solutions, relationships, etc. and 6 VOL. III #2
have YOU THINK! Sometimes I will appear to “defend” self. What you don’t know is that, in each instance whereby the “defense” was put forth in shared format, I received such thank-yous that they could not be counted. Further, two of the ones which proclaimed attack upon me in the most heinous man- ner--are now my most faithful friends and workers. God is in- deed wondrous in his mysterious manners of work. If I really wanted to share “fun” with you, I would publish in the Express the documents sent to me from William Cooper which no longer negated my projections but rather discounts his own prior “informers” and has publicly listed the ones who are still in the ser- vice of the CIA, etc., and set forth for disinformation/misinformation purposes in total. Please under- stand that there is often a valid reason behind those things which we write which may not be in- tended for a general reader--but rather, specific to one. We simply do the best we can and always, ones who subscribe are most wel- come to not renew a subscription if you so-choose. I would suggest, however, that if you stick with us, we’ll get around to your favorite subject as time limitations and ur- gent matters permit. It, unfortunately, is not a matter of us not telling you sufficiently “what to do”, it is rather, that no one seems to want to do of it. I will also have to tell you that if it is the bomb that will get you next--it is what I will talk about. Sorry! You are going to get truth herein and suggestions for actions which will ultimately work to change your plight--if you choose to ig- nore them all the “lack of me speaking” about them will do you no favors. Let me point out a very serious confrontation. Sananda, Ashtar, Hatonn, Dharma and Aton were directly confronted by Satan as Jehovah (IHIV), in this dwelling-- with witnesses present, giving cease and desist or be thrown into Hell! The energy was so violent that it caused a whirlwind around this dwelling for some three min- utes. It was presented in the form of a certified mailing bearing every curse available. You ones can ei- ther succumb to these attacks or you can stand strong--for they cannot touch you if you stay strong within the lighted forces. Evil energies can only cause you to act foolishly. A further interesting note, however, and should interest all of you readers; this energy has also separated out placement in Hell for all the evangelical preachers and their congregations, but not for the same reasons, for with them it is that the lies are so terrible to both sides that they are up for destruction. This was ac- companied by an exact date, for you who like dates--try May 5, 2000. This cap indeed be terrify- ing, especially if the CIA is after you, also, but I find strength and humor prevailing instead of terror- -it is debilitating, however. Do I take this lightly or belittle the bearer? Of course not, and nei- ther had you better do so. This is coming with full intent of follow- through by etheric means or physical methods. This is a total “notice” of intent to take us out of circulation--NOW! The intent is total and deadly and we certainly acknowledge it for that which it is. It is time you all begin to under- stand and comprehend the magni- tude of that which is come upon you as a global species--the time is at hand. Selah! Please arrange this Express to ei- ther go in this quantity of writing or rapidly add unto it--time is ex- tremely important. Walk and act in peace within--but keep walking and acting so that peace might abound all about you. In love and respect I take my leave. I salute i VOL. III #2 you for your interest and your will- ing service. Behold thine God for his radiance shall shine all about thee and His presence shall touch of thee and He shall make the= whole. Thank you for holding us in your prayers of protection for we are most aware of it and we of- fer our own protection and bless- ings unto you. Salu. ******* The Phoenix Journals: Sipapu Odyssey And They Called His Name Im- manuel Space Gate Spiral To Economic Disaster From Here To Armageddon Survival Is Only Ten Feet From Hell The Rainbow Masters AIDS, The Last Great Plague Satan’s Drummers Privacy In a Fishbowl Cry of The Phoenix Cruciftion of The Phoenix Skeletons In The Closet R.R.P.P. * *Rape, Ravage, Pillage and Plun- der of the Phoenix Rape of The Constitution; Death of Freedom RRPP-Vol. II You Can Slay The Dragon The Naked Phoenix; How, Who, Why, Where, What, and When The Bird was Plucked; A Guide To Do-It-Yourself Feather Growing The price is $10 per JOURNAL, 10% discount on orders of 4 or more. riod). THE LATEST PHOENIX JOURNAL Send orders and Payments to: America West Distributors, P.O. Box 986 Tehachapi, CA 93581. THE NAKED PHOENIX HOW, WHO, WHY, WHERE, WHAT AND WHEN THE BIRD WAS PLUCKED A GUIDE TO DO-IT-YOUR- SELF FEATHER GROWING by Gyeorgos Ceres Hatonn The subject of this Journal is the Federal Reserve System and the Federal Reserve banks. This is the one most important deception and subterfuge ever foisted upon the world. It actually is only the conduit through which the Con- spirators have perfected their “PLAN”. The Journal would be ten times this length if we un- folded details but while we would be unfolding you would be con- sumed. Let us please take the in- formation, confirm it if you will, and allow us to move into action. Let us quote Congressman Louis T. McFadden in a speech before Congress June 10,1932: Mr. Chairman, we have in this country one of the most corrupt institutions the world has ever known. I refer to the Federal Reserve Board and the Federal Reserve banks. The Federal Reserve Board, a government board, has cheated the Government of the United States and the people of the United States out of enough money to pay the national debt. The depre- dations and the iniquities of the Federal Reserve Board and the Federal Reserve banks acting together have cost this country enough money to pay the national debt several times over. This evil institution has impover- ished and ruined the people of the United States; has bankrupted itself, and has practically bankrupted our government. It has done this through the defects of the law under which it operates, through the maladministration of that law by the Federal Re- serve Board, and through the corrupt practices of the mon- eyed vultures who control it. Some people think the Federal Reserve banks are United States Government institutions. They are not government institutions. They are private credit monopolies which prey upon the people of the United States for the ben- efit of themselves and their foreign swindlers; and rich and predatory money lenders. In that dark crew of financial pi- rates there are those who would cut a man’s throat to get a dollar out of his pocket; there are those who send money into states to buy votes to control our legislation; and there are those who maintain an international propaganda for the purpose of deceiving us and of wheedling us into the granting of new conces- sions which will permit them to cover up their past mis- deeds and set again in motion their gigantic train of crime. Yes, there are things you can do to take action and we have laid them forth. Will it be easy? NO! You will need to start at “home” in the community and unify and get rid of the thieves and conspirators which you continually send back to be wardens of your prison and robbers of your property. They, too, are vulnerable to the nuclear bombs and confiscation--they just have forgotten as much. Your Senator is as physically mortal as are you and will die as quickly and suffer as greatly from the collapse - 8 VOL. III #2 which is coming. Preparation? You have all but waited too long, but you still have time, while the elite vie for position to see who will outdo who and gain the ulti- mate control--the messages, un- fortunately, of the prophecies tell you who that will be and those ones will bring devastation of physical nature--not just glean all property and wealth. In for a hard time? Yes! But also a wondrous time of unity, broth- erhood and freedom from bore- dom and degradation as fed to you by the silver spoons of the puppet masters. Which will it be, citizens of World Earth? Freedom or enslavement? The choice is yours, for God so loves this world that he again sends his Hosts and his being to show you the way! Who will see and hear?
