British diplo- macy had, in the meantime, in- duced the Arab League to admit Kuwait as one of its members, thus further buttressing its claim to independence, Arab forces be- gan to arrive in Kuwait by September, and in October the last of the British departed. But in December of the same year, the British placed their Middle East forces on a high alert, in re- sponse to reports of new Iraqi at- tempts to seize Kuwait, which did not, however, materialize. In October 1973, Kuwait was at the center of world attention as the venue of a meeting of the six largest Gulf oil producers which announced a 17% increase in the price of crude oil, in response to the Yom Kippur War involving Israel, Egypt, and Syria at that time. But in March 1973, an- other acute crisis involving Iraq had emerged. In that month, Iraqi troops occupied a police station in the locality of Sameta, some 2.5 miles inside Kuwaiti territory. PHOENIX JOURNAL EXPRESS A bulletin commenting on appropriate current news events, c tion of portions of Journals and answers of a genera1 nature tions not found in the existing Journals. darifica- to ques- OCTOBER 1990 VOLUME IV NUMBER 5 10/3/90 HATONN TODAYS WATCH May the wondrous mercy and grace of God abide with you through this troubled time. Hatonn present in the light of service. Precious ones, it was ever thus with man. Does it mean that if the world does not destruct this day that you no longer believe upon God? Again, I ask that you use your wisdom and reason! I remind you that only a tiny few desire to blow the world away in bloodshed and even they prefer to not annihilate the useful toys of manifes- tation. Others desire to control and depopulate the planet to better serve their own greed and consuming desire for power. Millions desire to “prove” of themselves on the battlefield of a Holy Jihad (Holy War) and others want to FORCE a way of life upon another in bigotry. And you, children of truth, have not finished our task of bringing the WORD of TRUTH unto the masses in intent and extent of God’s directives. Can we not accept the grace which allows us longer or must you have de- struction in order to believe? This is why I refuse to give dates and ONLY PROBABILITIES for it is a stupid fool who would project annihilation on any given day or moment for God projects that NO MAN SHALL KNOW! You of the public throw rocks at our people and shout, “Well, where is it? It didn’t happen. 1” and, “What if it doesn’t happen?” GET ON YOUR KNEES AND THANK YOUR CREATOR! We will tell you that which is PLANNED on your place- ment by ones desiring to control the world and YOU. No more and no less, what you do with that informa- tion is up to you. We effort to inject reason into the attention of the rulers and then we do as you--watch and be prepared. So few of you are PRE- PARED for any disadvantage that thousands will perish from “natural” disasters. Is it so much to ask that you get in preparation for that which you are told bv your own exnerts will come upon you? What will you do in Los Angeles or San Francisco when massive earth- quakes come upon you? Less than half of one percent have made any preparations what-so-ever and yet, your own projectors tell you the “big one” is coming--get prepared. Why do you pronounce us as evil and false if we simply tell you that which is al- ready known upon your placement? We are only here to give you truth of the word and that which is already outlaid for you. EXAMPLES We received in this place a document on the yesterday, published by NASA with updated guides (some in advance of events) as to that which would be released to the public regarding the shuttle’s troubles and fabricated bul- letins which would “protect” “national security”--right through the rocket launch of a few hours ago. It did however, describe items (albeit dis- guised--but sufficient for iden- tification) of intent and purpose of current satellites. IT ALSO STATED THERE WOULD BE SOME TWO DOZEN MORE! YOU SEE, NASA EMPLOYEES DIE, TOO! What of the new designs in aircraft seen about the area of Southern Cal- . . 1 Vol. IV #5 ifornia and Edwards Air Base? What about them? I have outlaid complete descriptions of your craft as well as Cosmospheres and even my own writers act surprised. Is it so hard to open your eyes and minds? Some- how, in listening to the call-ins on ra- dio stations, for the most part, you want proof of that which we say unto you. LOOK AROUND YOU, WE ONLY TELL YOU THAT WHICH IS GOING ON AROUND YOU! WE ARE NOT MYSTICAL NOR MAGIC. WE DESIRE YOU CON- FRONT THE TRUTH--NOT BE- LIEVE IN SPACE PEOPLE ONE WAY OR ANOTHER. WE ARE HERE TO REMIND YOU OF YOUR RELATIONSHIP TO GOD- -NOT PANDER OR PREACH SPACE COMMAND. Assuming the worst, however, Bush instructed Defense Secretary Cheney to inform the Senate Armed Services Committee on September 11 that, if the president so ordered, the U.S. would attack strategic targets inside Iraq regardless of whether or not So- viet military or civilian advisers might be at the Iraqi sites. Boy, do you see what a large rock and big hard place is now put forth for you ones to sit upon? As Gorbachev is already aware, but Bush seems slower on the uptake thereof, the shock and revulsion in the Soviet Union caused by the killing of Soviet military and civilian advisers in Iraq could lead to Gorbachev’s disappear- ance from the international scene, to say the very least. It would further, turn the “cold war” into a very hot one right fast! Now what will you do? And why might we give you projections of probabilities as to dates? Because they were planned in hard copy, and yet, perhaps, sanity would cause at least a postponement of such drastic incidents. The Israelis are in a frenzy, however, and wish to proceed at all costs and whether or not a subtle “stand-off” situation can be affirmed until year 1993 is wholly speculative for war is always caused by the least sane personage among the crowd and you have some real zingers in the in- sanity scope of hot-headed national rulers! THE U.S. DOES NOT HAVE THE CONTROLLING POWER OVER ISRAEL, DEAR HEARTS--THE ISRAELI ZION- ISTS CONTROL AMERICA! SO BE IT. Just another point or two I will make prior to signing off with this docu- ment which you will find announced later this day--for your conlfirmation. The most important, relative to the plans for attacking Iraq and Baghdad headquarters to “get” Hussein (for your confirmation of validiiy of our projected possibilities of today’s be- ing THE day for planned attack): al- ready PRESIDENT HUSSEIN KNOWS OF IT AND LISTENED TO THE TRUTH OF IT--HE IS NOT IN IRAQ! HE IS TAKING THIS PARTICULAR TIME TO CHECK HIS TROOPS ELSE- WHERE--IN KUWAIT! Another point I think you should pay attention to most closely for confir- mation regafiing your economy “screws”. Mr. Greenspan has now en- dorsed the budget proposal to reduce the deficit and has insured projected consequence with higher interest rates if THIS BUDGET IS NOT AP- PROVED--HE SAID AND I QUOTE: “YOU C4N COUNT ON A 7 Vol. IV #5
DECLINE IN INTEREST RATES IMMEDIATELY UPON PASSAGE OF THE PLAN!” Can’t get much more pointed than that, now can you? Aren’t you about sick and tired of this game of manipulation and puppet strings? So be it! Enough, Dharma, I think we have given enough chewing and perhaps there shall be some thoughtful swal- lowing of the hard lumps. The truth IS COMING FORTH and so shall it be in these days. Hatonn to clear, please. ******* THE PHOENIX JOURNALS: Sipapu Odyssey And They Called His Name Im- manuel Space Gate Spiral To Economic Disaster From Here To Armageddon Survival Is Only Ten Feet From Hell The Rainbow Masters AIDS, The Last Great Plague Satan’s Drummers Privacy In a Fishbowl Cry of The Phoenix Crucifixion of The Phoenix Skeletons In The Closet R.R.P.P.* *Rape, Ravage, Pillage and Plunder of the Phoenix Rape of The Constitution You Can Slay The Dragon The Naked Phoenix Blood And Ashes OUR NEWEST JOURNALS FIRESTORM IN BABYLON THE TIME IS COME by Gyeorgos Ceres Hatonn History is repeating itself--in ever shortening cycles. FOR YOU WHO STAND IN TRUTH--THERE SHALL BE PEACE IN THE VALLEY FOR YOU! GOD EXTENDS HIS HAND; HE HAS AGAIN SENT HIS “SON” AND THE “HOSTS” AFORE HIM. WHO WILL TAKE OF HIS HAND? PHOENIX JOURNAL EXPRESS A bulletin commenting on appropriate current news events, clarifica- tion of portions of Journals and answers of a general nature to ques- tions not found in the existing Journals. OCTOBER 1990 V~LUMETV NUMBER 6&7 10/6/90 HATONN TODAYS WATCH Oh chela, chela, chela; it is fine that we have missed a day in writing for you are bound by human limits and the physical form is fatigued. You have enough to concern about with the nerds in your Congress and Ad- ministration without writing about the BANKS today. Blessings be unto Charles for he has given us the breath assistance which helps the soul to find a bit of peace and order--I am most grateful. As we run and “mush” through these days of overload we shall simply have to cast aside that which is left unfin- ished. Reprioritize and allow it go for you cannot do of it all. We must be most careful, however, to make sure that our priorities are in order. Today, for instance, is a day in which the most important ones al- most did not come because it was perceived they could not bring of their little tots. We must remember that there are some twenty adults in this group, already in Tehachapi and any one or more could miss the meeting to keep the toddlers in safety, for any ones of you in the town could most easily miss of the meeting with me. Desiree’, you must not “wait” for volunteers, precious, lest you never get help. So be it. You must not just require that the young ones with children do of it for they are the most consumed of all as to restrictions. There are plenty of grandfathers and grandmothers in this crowd and I am pained that it has even come to such a discussion. NEVER DO THE BABIES OR CHILDREN ANNOY HATONN OR GOD--SOME OF YOU OLDER ONES, YES! THE CHIL- DREN--NO, NEVER! While we are on the subject of chil- dren, Dharma, I want you to take time this weekend to spend with the children and grandchildren. You have not seen them for months for we have not given you a day for rest or visiting in well over a year and we must remember that you cannot be all unto all. A family is a most pre- cious thing and we have required that you have neglected and been ne- glected far too much in these days of pressure and bringing forth the writ- ings. I cannot function as clearly when you are distressed and bur- dened to the extent you are these days. Blessings are unto all of you who have been pushed by the public for now the rewards can begin to flow back in the cycle. It has been and continues to be such a great re- sponsibility--especially to George and Desiree’ who must face those multi- tudes of hounding questions and al- ways accept the ones who are rude and insulting. You handle it superbly and soon, I shall come forth to do a little house cleaning when the station is nearby. You are welcome, at any time now, to interrupt your program when you get a “Fritz” on the line--to call upon me! I shall quite enjoy set- ting a few of these smart disinforma- tion specialists to correct percep- tions. I prefer to not bring this loca- tion nor Dharma into public en- counter as to set up a program but I most certainly am most happy to in- terject a bit of thought correction. I remind you ones of the “way out” of any encounter. Stand on truth and “this is MY PERCEPTION OF WHAT THIS OR THAT MEANS!” You do not need to, nor is it appro- priate, to speak FOR any of us au- thors and you must always leave an opportunity “to be incorrect in your projections”. This is not a correction unto you--it is simply to give you comfort. Another excellent response to dissenters is to simply keep asking if they have read ALL the Journals. If not, they have no basis upon which to argue and refuse to do so. It is an incredible task to interject fourselves into the atmosphere of blackness with the talk show hosts themselves for they are already “authorities” on every subject and cannot keep their mouths shut long enough for input. Always a good response when they allow you to not speak is to simply let them ram- ble and when they run down and ask why you do not answer--tell them, “If you shut your mouth, perhaps I can!” So much for this matter, we can dis- cuss it. I sh311 probably decline to allow Dharma to listen in to too many because she becomes quite irate at the insults unto you who are just trying to discuss a subject. It is much like watching a child do a piano recital--the comments from the crowd i Vol. IV #6&7
who think the child plays badly are quite painful to the parent. And al- ways remember: MY SHOULDERS FIT A NINE AND A HALF FOOT FRAME--THERE IS NO BURDEN I CANNOT CARRY FROM SUCH AS KIBITZERS AND I DO, IN FACT, ENJOY THE ENCOUNTER IMMENSELY. WHAT OF THE SHUTTLE LAUNCH? It is unimportant. The pay-load on this shuttle is follow-on for the one they did not get launched and it will simply be removed by the Russians at the appropriate time. Sun probes in- deed! This story is to cover for all of the heat sensing devices and sensitive apparatus they have on the system to monitor earth blasts. They don’t even bother to change the scenario any longer. I think, though, that the public might just be starting to “smell the toast burning”--frying, perhaps, in Fuel/Air holocaust. That was a BIG ONE THAT THE RUSSIANS GAVE UNTO YOU THROUGH THE “LEAK-VINE”. You ones have absolutely no defense against those weapons and that public projection is truth. It was just the Russian’s way of telling the bureaucrats to mind their business and not push too far. Mr. Bush didn’t like that bean spilling at all, on top of his slap in the face with the budget. Good for you people! Oh, the administration will make the piper (you) pay, but stand tall for you just pulled a coup on the criminals. You the public, John Q. Public, are going to get a real view of nasty poli- tics now and you can make some real headway if you don’t get sucked in by the lies they will conjure now. You can bet there will shortly be an inci- dent in the Middle East to punish you ones, but keep your eyes open and don’t let the truth fail to surface. WEAPONS Oh my yes, the Fuel/Air explosions are bad--and it should shut down the stupid passing out of chemical gas masks. Every one of you participants in the Middle East hocus pocus have the ability to utilize those missiles and they are as horrendous as any- thing you have conjured up to devas- tate a scattered army. You see the “beams” as such are not too effective in a “scattered” situation but these nice fire bombs can blanket miles in pure hell. The heat is so intense that you might as well be in a hydrogen blast except that radioactivity be- comes a moot issue. I believe you can also see why it would be the weapon of choice wherein your enemies (Global Cartel) are not yet ready to give up the functioning world. A city set afire by this weapon is go- ing to burn the entire area without selection because the entire area is blanketed in fire, but outlying areas in rural locations will not suffer greatly and there is not need for radi- ation panic. These are just dandy to set all the Middle Eastern oil fields afire and yes, Mr. Hussein will do that just as soon as Mr. Shamir sets the Saudi fields afire and creates the “incident” as planned. Funny things happen in this kind of a game of wits. You see, Israel passed out gas masks to all her population in order to dump chemicals on her own people to cause the “incident” which would start the war. It was a superb way to wipe out the Palestinians be- cause they wouldn’t have masks and Hussein would be blamed for the en- tire matter. Never underestimate the capability of the Russians who sprang this new weaponry on you the public because Shamir would be a total and visible fool to douse his own with chemicals now. Keep your eyes and ears open and pay attention for we are making some real progress and it will pick up momentum as we move along. NOTE THE DISTRACTORS The distracters shall be kept moving from one to another now as you all pay attention to the government closing operations; no one will even notice what happens to Keating, the senators involved, Neil Bush and thus and so. You will hardly notice when Bush calls a NATIONAL EMER- GENCY and takes over through Ex- ecutive Order under “national emer- gencv regulations”! Sorry about that- -but you had forgotten that he can do that and you needed reminding. He can take away every one of your Bill of Rights by the signature on an or- der--without ever touching the bud- get papers. Well, it has not eluded his notice nor the notice of those “advisers” and manipulators--why do you think you had to have a Middle East incident in the first place? Oh yes, it is that bad, dear ones--it is even worse for you will have to have some kind of a war anyway in order to pull off the whole thing. TAKING BACK CONTROL OF YOUR DESTINY AND GOVERNMENT IS NOT AN EASY TASK BUT SURELY YOU SEE THAT IT CAN BE DONE IF YOU HOLD TRUE AND RE- QUIRE THAT YOUR REPRE- SENTATIVES “MEASURE UP” TO YOUR DEMANDS. You will note that even the ones who quoted the Constitution--from CXi- fornia indeed (and I directly thank you letter writers for that is where it came from), did not mention the way outlined in the Constitution to bal- ance the budget and pay for these overburdens. Most do not even KNOW and the others are very, very careful to never let that get into your attention. Feel gratified, for a job well done--you made them stop and pay attention for they dared not run rampant right over you the people in the last two days--ones of the criminal element are getting nervous about their jobs, dear hearts, so lets keep them nervous. Even though we seem to walk through the shadows, we walk not alone for in the light are the pitfalls illuminated. Hold it ever in thine hearts. Keep ever in thine minds, also, that Gorbachev and Bush agreed that there should be no nuclear war in the Middle East until 1!992/93. Keeping the Israelis in line may be impossible but I believe you can see that some “good judgment” is coming into play from the direction of Russia -2 Vol. IV #6&7
as regards weapons, etc. No, it does NOT mean that there will not be war; it does mean that it becomes pretty stupid to press the luck in the matter for an awfully large number of people are going to get hurt and killed and YOU WILL NEED THEM LATER FOR THE NEXT WAR--SO, GOOD JUDGMENT WOULD BE TO CALL THIS ONE OFF. Israel, however, is being pushed to get that West Bank into her clutches and mad-men in a frenzy do foolish things. So be it. Dharma, allow us to close this as it is time for guests and you need a bit of respite before we begin our work during the remainder of this day. We can talk of these things during our meeting later today. Hatonn to stand-by as I clear the fre- quency, please. Salu 10/7/90 HATONN TODAYS WATCH Greetings in the beauty of the early morning while the quiet beauty awakens into the wonder of a day of radiance for our using. May we fill it with beauty for it has been given in love for our experience. AHO! Ha- tonn present; in service. As we begin this morning I would like to speak briefly regarding “receiving”. As more ones come into the circle of the Phoenix Journals it is perhaps time to again speak of “methods” of communication. There is nothing strange nor mystical regarding our transmissions--in fact, I shall herein, again, dissolve even the “mystery”. Mysticism is that which is conjured around myths, magic and usually a wondrous blending of the two. Mystery is that which is simply not yet known unto you personally-- not a “secret”, only yet unknown in fullness. My language is silent for the most part. I can speak but those with whom I communicate do not need written or spoken words, therefore, let us better define a “receiver”. I, for instance, do transmit on a frequency just as in a radio transmission. I be- lieve, however, a better way to de- scribe her “job”, if you will, is as a “translator”. I am continually asked why or how it is that I speak English. I do not speak English, I project thought forms and depend upon her data banks (and sometimes give her new vocabulary to better suit my de- scriptive needs) and vocabulary data. It is much as any translator who sim- ply “retells” a statement in a native language. Can anyone do it? Of course, all can do it--if you know the frequency and can “tune your radio”. Ones with a mission or who are re- ceivers have it simplified even more easily, however, in that we work most closely and the frequency is already set. Dharma’s “Hatonn” frequency is always “on” and two other frequencies always “on” and utilized by others. If you could move within her head you would run into a barrage of ever changing tones or “frequencies”, just like scanning a radio tuner. Her “automatic push buttons”, however, are pre-set for instant connection with my frequency because her pur- pose at this time is as my translator. I have constant attachment to her right receiver, Sananda Emmanuel (Christos) to her left and “Grandfather” to her central banks. This is being put in such simplified manner that we feel foolish but I be- lieve it is better clarified by rela- tionships with something which you have daily access. I, for instance, sim- ply pour in universal language for the most part--unless I am in the practice of a particular communications lan- guage for later use, and she translates the material. If the subject is techni- cal in nature and beyond her knowl- edge, I simply dictate and translate myself. If I utilize material already put to print, I utilize computer re- sources and basically, read the infor- mation--depending upon what my purpose might be for the written word--or, I will give her instructions as to resource to allow for proper spelling, etc. Your spelling of word symbols are atrociously complicated and unnecessary and your punctua- tion and prepositions totally absurd so I usually confuse them and write a lot of “and’s” when I should put “for”, etc. It is better to leave those things to an editor for when we are in com- munication Dharma is so finely “tuned” that we rarely interrupt for any purpose and we write as fast as she can type the symbols. It is quite interesting to observe, for as she translates and types there is fre- quently a word which will have all the proper symbols but all out of order. My point in this discussion is to allow you to receive a better description of this mechanism and get rid of the “mystical” format. We, further, never sit to communicate until all energies utilizing the system are cleared and “authorized” to utilize the frequency. Where exceptional receivers are “lost” is through that one error in ego judgment. A “hacker” can utilize the frequencies when allowed to so do--it is up to the receiver to prevent the in- terference. This is a mutual agree- ment relationship with great respect and understanding that I will never embarrass her, speak untruths in con- ceptual matters and she will write that which she understands not nor has nor has had access to the infor- mation. In other words, she clears to my frequency, writes that which I give her whether or not she agrees and re- serves her opinions for expression just as any reader of the material--af- ter the fact, just as would a translator from Russian into English. Often the opinion given by me, the speaker, and that of the “management”, her, vary considerably--but she does not have access to all the data scanners which are available to me. I hope I have responded in a manner that is not simply more confusing. FUEL-AIR EXPLOSIVES Within the past few days I am bom- barded with requests for additional information regarding the Fuel-Air 3’ Vol. IV #6 & 7
explosives that Saddam has. I have discussed these weapons in prior pa- pers but it is news to you the public and I am happy to re-identify the in- formation as well as remind you that all of the participants and potential major participants in any Middle Eastern war (actually, any war these days, anywhere) are equipped with everything because of the random dis- tribution of arms on the market as well as the nature of the elite under- cover agencies such as the CIA, Mossad, etc. ALL are equipped with ALL to serve the purposes of the Global Planners. Sophisticated killers are available to both sides of any disagreement in these days of ter- rorists. Russia has the technology, however, that all other governments lack and have been able to gain control from “position”. Some things, to be effec- tive, must have space capability for aiming, surveillance and focus in fir- ing. Russia can take out anything you can place in space at this time and has remarkable defenses against anything you can fire at her. Therefore, YOU (U.S. and Allies) have no defense against these Fuel-Air weapons but she has all of yours pin-pointed to ex- act location and can “beam” explode them on your launching pads. The day you utilize them for attack against Iraq, for instance, your army will find themselves blowing them- selves up in a most heinous manner. In Russia and now in Iraq, are in- stallations surrounding all in- stallations of importance which surveil the entire circumference of entry of any object, with ability to identify, see through the electronic shielding and intercept instanta- neously. Further, the space based weapons can identify and destroy any- thing you can get off the ground so far. The Fuel-Air explosives are not new but are extremely powerful and are the weapon of choice in encounters wherein radiation is undesirable. These weapons are the main reason the facade of gas-masks, chemical suits and other such nonsense is to- tally ridiculous--no one except Israel has any intention of such stupid encounters. Chemicals would be for distraction and “incident” value-- nothing more. Further, the “INCIDENT” would kill thousands of Palestinians and the Israelis with all their lovely new designer masks would survive a self-inflicted dousing- -blamed on the Iraqi terrorists. No, it won’t sell except to you who believe the drivel you read and are fed by the controlled media. Does your government know all this? Who knows exactly who knows what? Well, your government knows for sure, but only at the highest Estab- lishment level and now as some manipulated congressmen find out, it gets a bit more tedious to fool you completely. YOU must understand that Saddam is not a mad-man in any sense of the word and he would never stand off the entire world elite if he wasn’t pretty sure he had defenses which can allow him to prevail. He has no wish toblow up the world--not even the U.S.--he wants to sell his oil, make money for his nation and unite his people--inclusive of Kuwait. This battle is not even about oil, dear friends--IT IS ABOUT WORLD DOMINATION AND CONTROL. Fuel-Air explosive devices carry the destructive power of small nuclear bombs. Saddam has them and has them set on target--your military “invaders” playing soldiers in the Saudi desert. Your military leaders know you are targeted and know the consequences of this type of weaponry and yet your government continues to push the world to the brink of a most devastating war. The Fuel-Air explosives, or FAE’s, have a minimum of ten times the power of conventional explosives and create a tremendous fireball of in- tensely super-heated particles and create a shock wave of intense magni- tude over a relatively large area with total devastation in the concentrated impact area. BUT YOU HAVE NO RADIATION FALLOUT ASSOCI- ATED AS WITH NUCLEAR WEAPONS. They are surely not your “garden va- riety” of bows and arrows, spears and sling-shots. These are incredible blast-effect weapons, and what you can’t see can certainly kill you dead. You have no defense against such weapons nor any way to intercept the missiles bearing them. You would have no ability to effectively defend against such a missile-delivered war- head. Your leaders will tell you that they don’t “believe” Iraq has technol- ogy to “mount the system on mis- siles”. I TELL YOU THEY HAVE THE CAPABILITY AND AL- READY HAVE THEM IN PLACE FOR USE--INSTANTLY! THE SOVIETS HAVE SET THEM UP AND CONTINUE TO RENDER THEM TARGETED AND READY TO FIRE. You can know this to be truth by the new edict to allow some of the Russians to leave Iraq. That is simply to tell you that they are now finished with their work and that you had best “back off’. Thousands are remaining to man the scanner sys- tems. You are playing with destruc- tion beyond your imagination if you pursue this into war because someone is going to lose their “cool” and start firing these toys. It is amusing to note that now the senators, such as Glenn and Helms, are going to “insist” these weapons be looked into. More distracters, beloved ones. Can you really believe that a former astronaut who has flown in the face of the lies and de- ceits would not know of these weapons--especially ones who have taken bribes for their cover-ups in the government and against you the peo- ple? The noose tightens even more grip- pingly as you will find that the com- ponents and scientific knowledge to build the weapons came into Iraq from the German arms industry. The arms industry of the world simply sold to anyone who could buy and you of the super-powers paid for the “stuff” and supplied the technicians. . 4 Vol. IV #6& 7
It certainly is not complicated to fig- ure out--just hard to believe in your innocent naivety. A major German aerospace and de- fense firm, Messerschmitt-Bolkow- Blohm, conducted feasibility studies on an FAE device as part of a major missile project with the Egyptian government (oops, there went your $7 BILLION for garbage). That project terminated in about 1988 and all that dandy technology remained ready if the price was right--and the price will always be right at the appropriate time. Egypt simply turned around and provided all that nice technology to their beloved brother and friend, Iraq. WEAPONS ALL OVER THE MAP It is hard for me to understand your “sudden” surprise at these weapons in Iraq. It is most amusing indeed and seems to somehow conveniently coin- cide with a need for distraction while your Congress plays at budgets and “broke” government, etc. Could it be another “chemical” weapons scare to rally the troops (you the public) be- hind the controllers in order to “protect” your children? Will you never see that your Estab- lishment is setting itself up for total control and they will get there by any means possible? IT WAS YOUR PRESIDENT THAT BROUGHT YOUR NATION TO A STAND- STILL--AND IT IS YOUR PRESI- DENT THAT CAN NOW OVER- RIDE THE ENTIRE CONSTITU- TIONAL SYSTEM AND MOVE ON “EMERGENCY REGULA- TIONS” BY “EXECUTIVE OR- DER” AND PLANS TO DO SO-- JUST AS SOON AS THINGS ARE A BUNGLED AND ENTANGLED MASS OF DEMANDING POPULATION. YOU WILL DE- MAND THAT HE ACT AND IN SO-DOING, YOU WILL HAVE GIVEN AWAY YOUR CONSTI- TUTIONAL RIGHTS FOR ALL CAN BE HANDLED THEN UN- DER EMERGENCY REGULA- TIONS AND THE NEW LAWS ENACTED WILL ALLOW IT TO HOLD FOR A MINIMUM OF FIVE YEARS, DEAR FRIENDS. BY THEN IT WILL ALL BE OVER BUT THE CRYING. The weapons in point are in the ar- senals of the Soviet Union, Israel, China, France, Germany, Spain and several Third World nations in ad- dition to Iraq. This is well known by the Pentagon which just happened to forget to mention it to you the people and/or Congress. Besides, “Gorby” told Mr. Bush all of this at their “summit”. How long will you the public allow of this? It seems likely that you will begin to pay better at- tention in the wake of the budget vote. It is not so simple, however, for either way it would go would be to your disadvantage for you have al- lowed laws to become active which allow for total bypass of the Congres- sional and Constitutional “system”. You CAN, however, recover it if you want to badly enough for it is up to you the people to unify and they can- not stop you for at this point ALL is not lost to your use. If, however, you do not stand and refuse this treat- ment, you will lose for with each de- feat you are more binded. You are now beginning to experience the “proof” you keep demanding from me! You are experiencing the steam- roller in motion and running amok over all in its wake toward Estab- lishment control. The action is mandatory, from the U.S.A. You are the last population within a nation with the ability to stand in any measure of freedom at all. The Russians are gaining ground on you, however. Of course it will not be easy or without effort to turn this tide the other direction and re- cover your freedom--but it is not yet too late if you take your stand--you proved as much by your refusal to ac- cept the bounds of the ridiculous budget. You can now see that it is your President acting in dictatorial fashion who single-handedly has put the whip to your backsides. He is giving you a show of power and don’t overlook as much. He is counting on you to back off and demand passage of the hardship package on yourselves just to get his permission to operate your country again. The Iraqi dinar became around a 20th of the (value of the) Kuwaiti dinar after it had been higher in value than the Kuwaiti currency in 1980. Having seen all doors closed in front of us for a solution that might reassure the Iraqi people about their present and their future, including the failure of the negotiations which we conducted in Jedda on 31 July 1990 with the rulers of Kuwait be- 11 Vol. IV tween the delegations from our side headed by the Vice Chairman of the Revolution Command Council and the delegation from their side headed by the former Prime Minister of Kuwait. We were left with no other alternative but to take the action which we took on 2nd August 1990. In order to halt danger, rectify an his- torical injustice and place Iraq in a position of self reassurance and a ca- pability to serve its nation and hu- manity at large, contrary to what President Bush tells you about Iraq having invaded Kuwait without any Kuwaiti provocation against Iraq, here are some extracts from the warning which we repeatedly ex- pressed to the rulers of Kuwait, but in vain. These warnings were made in addition to others, which we kept un- published. We addressed the rulers of Kuwait in the presence of all of the Arab heads of state during the meet- ings of the Baghdad Summit Confer- ence on 30 May 1990 by saying: “War occurs sometimes through soldiers and damage is inflicted by explosives, killings or coup attempts. At other times, war occurs through economic means. To those who do not intend to wage war against Iraq, I say that this is a kind of war against Iraq.” Then I stated the following on 16 July 1990 in my annual address to the na- tion celebrating the anniversary of Iraq’s National Day, the anniversary of the 1730 July R&olution. “Because the people of Iraq, who have suffered this deliberate jnjustice, have enough faith in their rights to self-defense and the defence of their rights, they shah never forget the saying ‘rather heads be cut off than sustenance’. If words fail to provide protection, then decisive action must be taken to restore the usurped rights to their owners.” Does not all this represent warnings made in advar)ce but in vain? Does this not constitute a provocation, in- deed, a flagrant aggression against Iraq? Is not all this evidence enough for understanding the measures we took on and after 2nd August 1990? President Bush knows all these facts #6&7
along with more events substantiating the meaning and the legitimacy of the measures that we have taken. His Administration followed events closely. The U. S. government and Congress were escalating the cam- paigns against Iraq and preparing draft resolutions for further measures of boycott and blockade to be im- posed against Iraq in the political, economic and other fields. All this had happened prior to the 2nd of Au- gust, 1990. The American measures were being taken against us as a re- sult of our repeated warnings to the government of Kuwait. Now after that has taken place, and regardless of any disagreement or agreement on the methods used, is it practical or logical to call for things to be re- turned to how they were before the 2nd of August, 1990, including the re- turn of the Sheiks of Kuwait who spent their time amassing wealth and women to the extent that some of them became unable to distinguish his own children in view of their great number? Indeed, the situation was such that one of them one day ex- pressed his desire to marry a young girl whom he had come across by chance on a previous occasion, only to discover that the girl in question was, in fact, one of his own daughters. God save us all. On the 5th of August, 1990, it was agreed that an Arab Summit Gon- ference would be held comprising Yemen, Jordan, Saudi Arabia, Egypt and Iraq in order to discuss the new situation and to find a solution to the crisis. Instead of convening this con- ference to which the parties con- cerned had all agreed, we were sur- prised to see the idea of the confer- ence closing, by the friends of the United States which had given them instructions to that effect, by the en- try of armies to the lands of Arabia and the Islamic sanctities of the Ara- bian Peninsula and by the other res- olutions of the U. S. This was how both we and the international com- munity lost the chance for an Arab solution, for a calm inter-Arab dis- cussion of the issue. While this has been the case in the current crisis, we know that both the U. S. and its allies had encouraged an Arab solution to the Lebanese question for which an Arab committee was formed with the encouragement of the U. S. and the subsequent blessing of the Security Council. Saudi Arabia was the prime mover in that affair. You know, Ladies and Gentlemen, that the people of Lebanon have been a more vital contributor to humanity than the Sheiks of Kuwait, yet we see the U. S. Administration exerting tireless efforts to appease the ruler of Syria which occupies Lebanon. The statement issued in Damascus at the end of Baker’s visit on the 13th and 14th (of September), instantly re- vealed that fact. The question is, therefore, one of politics, not of principles. Contrary to what Bush has tried to tell us in his message to the people of Iraq, since the issue is political and not one of principles in the facts of U. S. policy, and since the question re- mains to be a, matter of opinion in which each one sees matters on the basis of his own judgement and in- terest. Let us then resort to dialogue rather than arms as the road to a common understanding and accept- able solutions in such a situation. The Arabs will be better equipped to resolve their problems amongst themselves. If it is desired that the international community should participate in resolving the crisis and problems of the region as a whole, then the best course to adopt towards this end would be what we called for in our initiative of 12 August 1990, when we proposed that all the issues of the region in Palestine, Lebanon and the Gulf should be discussed to- gether and on the same level in the Security Council with a view to aim- ing at the same principles and criteria to be applied to all issues, while tak- ing into consideration the special na- ture and background of each issue. This is the serious way to reach a comprehensive and lasting solution to all the problems and crises of the region, in the forefront of which is the Palestinian question without 12 Vol. IV whose solution the region can never regain its calm or stability. Those who view with responsibility the secu- rity of the region must address all the factors preceding the 2nd of August, 1990, in the forefront of which are the Palestinian question and the occupa- tion of Lebanon by the Syrian army. They should also view the question of Kuwait realistically and in accordance with its historical background as an integral part of Iraq. We have pro- posed that initiative which seeks to resolve all outstanding issues in the region in a manner that insures the achievement of a comprehensive and lasting peace and security. Do you know what has happened, Ladies and Gentlemen? Bush re- jected our initiative, even before seeing its text, and when we knew that the U. S. Administration was plan- ning military action against Iraq based, in the beginning, on a false pretext that Iraq had intended to in- vade Saudi Arabia, a pretext dis- missed by naked facts. It occurred to us that one of the means of giving the U. S. Adminis- tration a better chance for thinking while allowing all parties concerned additional time which could be used for dialogue would be to prevent some foreigners, including U. S. citi- zens, from leaving the country and to host them as guests in the houses of our staff. At the scientihc and eco- nomic establishments this measure was used, along with other ways, in order to prevent the outbreak of a devastating war whose damage would be immense to those rushing to it. In any event, we are human and feel the pain of having had to take this mea- sure, in spite of the fact that there are those who keep telling us that the imposition of an economic blockade against Iraq, depriving it of food, medicine and even children’s milk is, in itself, an act of war which allows us under international law to detain the subjects of those countries responsi- ble for the blockade. This was what the USA itself did during the 2nd World War when it detained even its own citizens of Japanese origin. Yet I #6&7
still say that we are truly pained by this and wish to see the people of Iraq and the National Assembly repre- senting them, given any guarantees or undertakings from the United States of America pledging its commitment not to lodge war and aggression against Iraq, a pledge that would en- able us immediately to allow all for- eigners to leave the country, if they so wished. This was what we proposed in our initiative of 19 August 1990, which was again immediately rejected by the USA without any discussion or inquiry. I have expressed publicly my desire to have a TV debate or discussion with Bush in order to let the world public opinion, including that of the Ameri- can people, know the facts in detail but Bush has turned down this pro- posal which is why you find me forced now to burden you with details. A public TV discussion with Bush would have generated for viewers ev- erywhere greater vitality and given them a better chance to make their own judgements. In spite of this, however, Bush complained to you that he could not predict what Sad- dam Hussein would do, or know how Saddam Hussein would think. I ask you in the name of God, how could Mr. Bush know Saddam Hussein or his comrades in the leadership when Bush refuses to have a direct discus- sion with Saddam Hussein or enter into a direct debate with him on tele- vision? When we invite Bush to a discussion we do not need to beg his or any party’s acceptance of the idea. We propose the debate basically out of respect for world opinion, includ- ing the public opinion of the U.S. All we seek in such debate would be to disclose the lies and false allegations, so that people are better informed of the issue in question, and hence bet- ter equipped to make their own deci- sions on the basis of what they see as clear and concrete facts. Should not the opportunity of the debate or the discussion be seized upon by the parties concerned in or- der that opponents may better know each other? Had Bush viewed the matter in a truly responsible and se- rious manner, free from any precon- ceived objectives, should he not have agreed to enter into the proposed TV debate? If Bush had truth on his side, why should he evade debate and di- rect discussion? Saddam Hussein’s way of thinking is no great secret, as Bush seems to suggest. Saddam Hus- sein’s comrades in the leadership, the people of Iraq and the world, know him well, and can draw their own con- clusions about what he has not said in relation to any forth coming action taken towards known events requir- ing a response through words or con- duct. There is nothing hidden in the policy of Iraq for Bush has no agents in our leadership nor does he have many spies in our society as some of the U. S. authorities concerned have indeed publicly complained. If Bush and other professional politi- cians in the West wanted to know more about the leadership of Iraq, then we say the following: “The lead- ership of Iraq is a group of God- fearing mortals sharing beliefs of all true worshippers of God, aspiring to please God Almighty and serve their people while refusing to serve tyrants. Unenticed by temptation and unin- timidated by the threats of tyranny, we serve our people and our Nation deeply and sincerely, and through this we find that we serve humanity at large. We are proud to refuse serving tyrants. We protect with our very lives the rights and resources of our people. We neither plunder them nor keep them to ourselves in banks. (As is being done by the allies who are the servants of the U.S. Administration amongst the rulers of the region.) Serious in matters of se- riousness; compassionate amongst each other and towards all God- fearing and genuine servants of God; firm in the face of blasphemy, injus- tice and the exploitation that op- presses people and leads to poor people; we do not bend in the fight for Truth, or in determining what we should take, or give. We reject the subjugation of people by any force and call for liberty to be granted to all as commanded by God. Further still, Vol. IV if more is required of us, then we re- main fighters in the name of God and the principle of Truth; freedom fight- ers against injustice and its perpetra- tors true to our word.” If these signs are not sufficient enough, with the right conclusions to be made by the U. S. Administration or others, then this means that those concerned do not find these qualities to be necessary for those whom they regard to be their friends. Amongst the rulers of the region, they have not been used to seeing any of these at- tributes in those rulers, a fact for which we bear no guilt. The guilt is theirs and it is they alone who will bear the consequence. The day for which we prepare ourselves, is the day of judgement in front of God. Our people and history, when steps, God forbid, go astray, we respect world public opinion, when it is in a posi- tion in which it is formed only on objective and a fair basis. Other than this will be the plan of the Devil. The plan of the Devil leads to an abyss yielding no proof and leaving nothing to its rebirth but vice. The weight of God’s punishment will equal the acts of those tempted to go astray. We, our people and our na- tion, desire peace as much as peace is desired by the good amongst you, Ladies and Gentlemen. We want peace but we want it to be compre- hensive and durable, rather than just a temporary and superficial arrange- ment leading to an even more violent explosion at a later stage. We do not want war in which we have had enough experience and which we know in detail. While our difficult circumstances and war have provided us with the resilience required for the responsibility and honor of defending our homeland and principles, those same circumstances and the war pro- vided us, also, with ample op- portunities to Consider deeply and pa- tiently any step which we take. Bearing the responsibility of such a step in honor and firmness, we fear no threats from tyrants and will not fall prey to their temptation. #6&7
Mr. Bush, Ladies and Gentlemen, is sending your sons to a war which has no human value or meaning, save fa- tal arrogance fueled by the capabili- ties of a super power used to issuing commands which the weaklings have to obey. All must remember, God is omnipotent. Bush wants to bring back the sorrows of the U. S. and humanity by repeating the Veit Nam experience, only this time the ordeal will be more violent, and demand greater sacrifices, and cause bigger losses. Bush tells you, Ladies and Gentlemen, that he and others are capable of inflicting quick strikes against their targets and end the war in that way. You should know, how- ever, and here I do not mean to issue a threat for we threaten no one, but only to describe faithfully how we see things and what our decisions are. You should know that if Bush de- cided to start a war, it would not be up to him to end the war. The end of such a war would be very much linked to its impact and the determination of the people that has decided to confront tyranny with unyielding strength for as long as both it and its nation remained on the side of Truth. The United States, Ladies and Gen- tlemen, would not lose anything if the Devil of aggression and war were to be removed from Bush’s forehead, and if the means of war and destruc- tion were to be removed from the area and the burden of occupation and the degradation of Arab and Moslem sanctities were to be lifted, but the Iraqis and the Arabs, on the one hand, would lose their humanity and their objectivity for a free life and dignity, should Bush have his way in achieving the desire of his ill-moti- vated self. The Arabs would be under a circumstance without honor or meaning, without a presence to be proud of or a future insuring life for them and their children. Whenever we have talked in the past and whenever we find it our duty to remind others of the qualities of the Iraqi people and its human role, of the qualities of the Arab Nation and its human role, we also remind of the death of civilization established through their minds and efforts of the culture which they pioneered to the benefit of humanity as a whole, when we say that the depth of civilization in Iraq stretches back more than 5000 years. In fact, it was Iraq which first taught mankind letters and writing, more than 5000 years ago. And we are marabi and acting this famous code, around 4500 years ago. The land of the Arabs has always been, by God’s choice, the place of decent for Divine Messages, and the cradle for God’s messages. The Arabs have al- ways been, and still are, the apostles of constant faith entrusted with the task of spreading the Word of God all over the world. The guidance and faith that has reached your hearts, Ladies and Gentlemen, have been conveyed to you by the Arab faithful. We have never placed Iraq or the ASC above humanity in anything. We said in the past, nor do we threaten anybody with the qualities of the people of Iraq and the Arab Na- tion, although the depth of these qualities must be linked with the depth of civilization--qualities such as endurance and patience, resilience through adversity and readiness to fight in the defence of Truth. As he addressed his message to the people of Iraq, Bush wanted to voice a threat when he talked about the qualities of the people of the United States by saying, “We, as Americans, there is no nation on Earth with greater resolve, with stronger steadi- ness of purpose.” He also placed the American people above other nations when he gave himself the right to lead mankind, and all states, in his address to the U. S. Congress on the 11th of September, 1990. In this way Bush is, in fact, promoting a form of Neo- nazism. God is the Only, is the One and Only. He alone is the One, unchallenged, supreme leader of mankind and the universe. Any claim deviating from this is a false claim, void of Truth, and bound to be repelled. Glory is not achieved by aggressive force but through justice, fairness and good ex- . 14 Vol. IV ample. Humanity would see virtue in the humility of those blessed by God with the power, the power to which God remains capable of taking back from them, if they fail to show hu- mility and persist along their path of misguidance to glory that comes from power alone can be removed by counter power. The glory that comes through sheer force is a glory that can be removed by counter force. It is in- deed a glory doomed to oblivion from the moment at which it begins. Bush talked to Congress on the 11th of September, 1990, about the impor- tance of strength and vitality as the true elements of leadership. He made no mention of God and did not speak of wisdom. If man loses the link between himself and God, he loses his Spirit. If he loses wisdom he will, even if he continues to possess strength and vitality, lose human re- spect and influence because he will not be active in what he says or does. I do not think that you will disagree with me that whoever loses his soul and respect of others, will lose all else. Indeed, more important than anything else, is that Bush tells you that he brought his armies, and the armies of his allies; to our region to defend the life style of the American people, irrespective of the selfish un- dertone of his statement in which the speaker fails to see the interests of others while pursuing hiqown, and of the particular danger it carries to humanity as a whole, if it were to maintain its generalized dimension. You ought to ask Bush, “Who is ac- tually threatening the life-style of the American people?” Have the Arabs or Iraq ever threatened the life styles of the American people?” He tells you that he came here, to the land of our nation, to protect .oil and that Iraq should not be allowed to possess 20% of oil reserves. This makes it in- cumbent upon you, and us all, to ask Bush whether he thinks Iraq intends to sell oil or drink it? Iraq sells its oil to its usual market in the West. Iraq sells oil to the U. S. and the West in general. That was the case up to the 2nd of August, 1990, when Iraq was #6&7
selling 113 of its oil to the U. S. alone. In any event, if Bush wants to issue a new law by which to decide the per- centage allowed to any given country of any particular resource or com- modity, including the resources of the United States such as grains, then I suggest that Bush should submit a proposal to that effect to the United Nations. It will then be up to the United Nations to make a decision which will have to be complied with by all concerned and accommodated in the United Nations Charter. But if Bush thinks that he is alone and subjugates humanity and interferes and repels of its life and its forces, then he is mistaken. This policy of his is bound to isolate the U. S. from the rest of the world and make it hated and despised. It will also cause those who perpetuate this policy to be cursed till the day of judgement. I don’t wish to burden you with more, but you ought to remember that thousands of children may die of malnutrition due to the lack of chil- dren’s milk and that the health of many people will deteriorate for lack of adequate food, and their life will be in danger. The stoppage of food, children’s milk and medical supplies is the result of a measure initiated by the U.S. and the Bush Administration in violation of the U. N. Charter and of the international norms. President Waldheim stated on his visit to Baghdad on the 25th of Au- gust, 1990, that such an inhumane act cannot be compared in its impact with any other action, regardless of the different descriptions given to it. This measure was taken by a party to which no threat was posed, while Iraq, in spite of the threat posed on its sovereignty and security of its na- tion, did not take any measure similar to that action or anywhere near it in description or motives in any form or shape. Those who talk about for- eigners prevented from travel ought to remember that the whole people of Iraq is now prevented from travel and confined to within its borders. In view of the measures taken against the means of travel, the last being the proposal propagated by certain par- ties for the imposition of an air blockade against our civilized nation. Have you ever known or heard about measures more boorish, inhumane and unjust than those measures? When Bush is asked why he opposes the reunification of Iraq and Kuwait while supporting that of Germany and not objecting to unity in other parts, he may say to you that he is not against unity but he opposes an an- nexation by force. Without going into details and arguments, you can inform Bush that the Sheiks of Kuwait were themselves installed there by force, by Britain. They did not come to rule through democracy or elections. Kuwait, too, has been severed from Iraq by force and all the instances I have referred to which were made through democratic means, through unification and which were tried by the Kuwaiti Leg- islative Council in 1938 and were suppressed. Kuwait, Iraq’s severed part, has been used as a base of con- spiring against Iraq, instead of being the part that should support it. There was no other alternative better than what was done, Ladies and Gen- tlemen, and we thank God for what has happened. The claim made by Bush that the majority of Arabs are with the U.S. is inaccurate. I do not want to describe other than this, if the desire is there, to ascertain the position of the Arabs that Bush agrees to the setting up of a working group comprising members of the U. S. Congress to meet with representa- tives of the people of Iraq from the National Assembly with a view to conducting a joint investigation into an assessment of the information and facts of the issue. Bush has to promise you in advance however, that he will let you know the true facts as they are, in which case you will have known for certain that the Arab Na- tions stand entirely with Iraq and that this nation, along with the Moslems of the world, reject the presence of your armies on the land of Moslem sanctities in the Arabian Peninsula. 15. Vol. IV This nation is on the side of Truth, not falsehood, and no one should be deceived by a bunch of mercenaries, weaklings and traitors shaking within the confines of their hiding places for fear of the peoples’ anger, especially now that they have been isolated from the course of truth pursued by our faithful. The U. S. Administra- tion , Ladies and Gentlemen, is plac- ing you in a critically embarrassing situation, in addition to the fact that it places you all along with us and the whole of mankind, on the edge of a bottomless abyss. The U. S. Adminis- tration is causing you embarrassment as Americans in that it keeps talking about and bragging over democracy while allying itself to the most back- ward of governments. Governments that are the most unrepresentative of their people, most distant from democracy and most distant from God, the One, the Omnipotent and the Almighty. The people of Iraq have expressed their views through their demon- stration in which they took to the streets in roaring waves, protesting what Bush has said in his message to them. They came out immediately af- ter the broadcast of his message in every town and village of Iraq, and here I have said my word to you on behalf of the leadership of Iraq, in- deed, on behalf of all God, all of the good and faithful Arabg and Moslems. God is the source of suc- cess. God is great. There are those who are being told, “Your enemy has mustered a great force against you. Fear them, through war, tenacious in their faith.” And we reply, Allah’s help is all sufficient for us. He is the best protector, Holy Koran. ******* THE PHOENIX JOURNALS: Sipapu Odyssey And They Called His Name Im- manuel Space Gate Spiral To Economic Disaster From Here To Armageddon Survival Is Only Ten Feet From Hell The Rainbow Masters #6&7

PHOENIX JOURNAL EXPRESS< A buttetin commenting on appropriate current news events, clarifica- tion of portions of Journals and answers of a general nature to ques- tions not found in the existing Journals. purposes OCTOBER 1990 VOLUME IV NUMBER 8 lo/lo/90 HATONN TODAYS WATCH Hatonn present in the light of truth and in service unto God and Man, salu. I have waited until today to speak of the happenings in Jerusalem for I wanted all of you to pay attention and I, too, needed to witness that which would come forth through your cover-up boxes regarding the Pales- tinian/Israeli conflict precipitated on Monday last. It may have been a day of remembering Columbus in Amer- ica but it was a Zionist Holy Day in Jerusalem. THE MOST IMPORTANT INCIDENT OF YOUR CENTURY TOOK PLACE AND THE FACTS ILAm BEEN KEPT FROM YOU TO THE EXTENT OF THE ABILITY OF YOUR CON- TROLLERS TO DO SO. SIGN OF SIGNS THE JEWISH “WORSHIPERS”, SO- CALLED, WHO tf!ERE GOING WITHIN THE SACRED GROUNDS OF THE MOSQUE ON DOME OF THE ROCK (CLAIMED BY THE JEWS As “TEMPLE MOUNT”) TO LAY THE KEY FOUNDATIm STONE IN cEREM0my -- E’ w OF SIGNS . ’ LITTLE CHELAS! m SIGN dF SIGNS! Why were the Palestinians present? Because the “Jews” had not come to their usual “wailing wall” to have wor- ship--they had brought the founda- tion stone onto the Sacred ground of the holiest of holy Mosques of the Islamic religion. It was well planned and known about Jerusalem and taunted into the faces of the Arab community. Why did the Palestinians throw stones? Because they have no American supplied weapons and as- sault rifles with which to defend the populace--all they have to defend self and property, for the most part, are stones! Why did not the American people become informed of this? On re- ceiving of the information of the up- rising--it was decreed by “national se- curity” regulations to stop the infor- mation from the controlled media on the pretext of “causing undue panic and desire for reprisal against Israel”. IT SLIPPED OUT, HOWEVER, ON TWO OCCASIONS. IT WAS IMMEDIATELY SQUASHED BUT IT DID COME FORTH ON TWO PROGRAMS AND NOW IT SHALL HAVE TO BE SPOKEN OF IF ENOUGH RAISE VOICES IN PROTEST AND DESIRE FOR INFORMATION. **ON THE EVENING NEWS AT 500 P.M. SANCTIONS AGAINST ISRAEL The day has passed to make righteous impact in the eyes of the world re- garding any statement from the United Nations Security Council and/or the U.S. You have just proven your ties and affiliations with Israel in the incident which began on Monday last. Funny thing, when Saddam so- called “invaded” Kuwait--the sanc- tions and denouncements were al- ready written, signed and operative. Do you not see the point? Brothers, to be blind is one thing--to refuse to open thine eyes and SEE is quite an- other! If there is any denouncement regarding Israel’s actions it will be clouded with excuses and meaningless nothingness. The plan is in full oper- ation and to distance through rhetoric and oratory is but part of the plan--IT IS REPEATED AGAIN AND AGAIN AND I HAVE POINTED THE INCIDENTS DI- RECTLY TO YOUR ATTENTION OF 1982, JUST IMMEDIATELY PAST IN OUR WRITINGS. IT IS PART OF THE COVER-UP AND “DISTANCING” PROCEDURE WHILE MYRIADS OF OTHER DISTRACTORS ARE LAID FORTH TO CONSUME YOUR INTEREST AND POCKETBOOKS. By the way, pay attention to that which your military proponents es- pouse. For instance, consider the Stealth B-2 bomber under con- sideration for funding--while no one is looking. By the very words of the leaders it is noted that, “Russia con- tinues to upgrade and refine all their equipment and stealth capabilities.” The same leaders demand, “...continued support and continuing construction by ‘Northrup’ for they are the ones with the secret technol- ” All this and “security”, too. 8hing is revealed for reasons of “national security”, even to not al- lowing discussion of the open trea- sonous fraud known to be perpe- trated by Northrup on you the peo- ple. Oh yes, these things even make it to your news channels and your government channels which you call C-SPAN and C-SPAN II. But it is in- deed boring and frightful watching and always the most important com- mittee hearings are DURING YOUR SPORTS AND SIT-COM PROJECTIONS OF BEST RAT- INGS TO KEEP WEWERS TO AN ABSOLUTE MINIMUM IN NUM- BERS. RELATIVITY I will go back to the discussion re- garding mistreatment of Kuwait by Iraq and point out a possible reason for the push to condemn Saddam in order to sway public opinion. You have a Holy War brewing which shall be the worst ha pening to come on the planet an % you quibble over “reading my lips”. Let us consider the U.S. PROTECTION of terrorists and payment in the sum of $400 million dollars (personally) to Hafez al-As- sad--REMEMBER HIM? Arrests without cause, torture of the most heinous kind, summary prison hangings, shootings, police murders and official extortion have become “everyday threats” to the Syrian peo- ple under the dictatorship of Hafez al-Assad under this new and Un-Holy alliance against his brothers and evil alliance with the U.S.’ UN! Assad has imprisoned and massacred tens of thousands of innocent citizens in or- der to perpetuate his repressive regime in power. Where is your UN back-up to free those people? You have only joined in the horror and paid-off the hit-man handsomely in- deed. These are the stark and blatant find- ings of one of your own councils which you seem to mouth respect for and honor as bearing integrity, the UN Human Rights Commission. They have compiled an investigative report and have scheduled release of same during the current session of the General Assembly--how much at- tention do you think it will receive under the circumstances? It has al- ready been postponed in the offering to the Assembly because it has run into unexpected extreme opposition from U.S. officials. The reason: Assad, who has joined the multinational mobilization against Iraq in the Persian Gulf, is now regarded by the Bush ad- ministration as a “key ally” deserving pay-offs and protection from public disgrace. This has been fully con- firmed and reported by Washington intelligence sources. The Establishment media, beating the war drums “like a percussion band conducted by Israel”, as former UN press aide Hjalmar Tonggren put it, ignored the cover-up of Syria’s crimi- nal record and continuing horror ac- tivities. TRUTH ALWAYS “OUTS” IN TIME “The facts can’t be concealed forever”, warned Tonggren, who served on the public information staff of the world organization’s Human Rights Corn- mission before he took a sabbatical to write. “Our study contains the find- ings of several rights groups, includ- ing Amnesty International and other organizations. Our conclusions are true, and the truth will out,” says Tonggren. Well, there are some pretty good misinformers in those groups who invent truth to suit the needs of the moment--however, as we have described recent Assad iniqui- ties, I am pretty sure the document will be fairly accurate in most in- stances. Let us look at portions of this “shelved” draft report and check some of the revelations being squashed: The Assad regime is sustained by 17 different secret-police and coun- terintelligence services employing more than 100,000 agents. That is a huge number of enforcers to watch over a nation of some 12 million. By comparison, to be comparable, the U.S. would need more than a million FBI agents. It is concluded that the Assad ad- ministration is a “police government”. The secret service chiefs, almost ex- clusively Alawite military officers with personal links to Assad, make all meaningful decisions. Well, where is 7 Vol. IV #8
your freedom? It appears to me that in this instance you are no different in context--you, too, have become a po- lice government! The police instruc- tors are right now deciding that which they will “take” from you taxpayers and citizenry--by gun if necessary! The Assad regime holds an estimated 17,000 political prisoners. These are not in nice comfortable “Club Fed” facilities such as you have for your white-collar criminals. A black man in the South can be incarcerated at hard labor for life for stealing a pack of cigarettes (and has been) while ones who have stolen your nation and all your assets learn tennis and con- tinue to run your nation. Once in the hands of the ubiquitous secret police of Assad, few suspects escape torture of the most cruel and often revoltingly sadistic type* Among the most widely used “interrogation instruments” used by Assad’s agents are the so-called al- Abd al-Aswad (“the black slave”), a mechanical device which slowly drives a heated rod into the victim’s most sensitive body parts, and the “al- Kursi”, an iron chair designed to twist and gradually break the victim’s legs and ultimately his spine. Thousands of innocent citizens are hauled in and mistreated each year simply as random spot checks on popular “attitudes and lurking dis- content” against the regime. But prisoners suspected of real opposi- tion activities or criticism of Assad are tortured with incredible intensity for months and occasionally, if the individual survives, for years. CONSPIRACY BY Oh, you don’t want to believe this? Well, this all comes from the same group telling you of all the other atrocities and you will note that these are the very methods TAUGHT BY THE MOSSAD. Where does this put your nation in the line-up? You have just paid this man off in taxpayer money! Mr. Baker dines and plans with this leader and bargains your taxpayer money AND THAT OF IS- RAEL--IN HALFSIES, along with enforced contributions by Arab na- tional rulers trying to save their wealthy kingdoms. Two hundred million comes directly from U.S. tax- payers, $200 million from Israel (with the original money assets for same coming directly from you the U.S. taxpayer ‘to and through Israel’, and the other $400 million as collection from wealthy Arab world “rulers” trying to save all those assets from their own people). The report says that to heap political favors such as the suppression of the UN Human Rights Report, as well as payoffs and other benefits of an emerging alliance on such a repre- hensible regime, “humiliates America and signals that our military deploy- ment in the gulf has no moral pur- pose”, says a veteran analyst on the State Department’s Near Eastern desk, asking not to be quoted by name. “An alliance with Assad means complicity in some of the most hor- rifying atrocities and genocidal crimes of recent history.” So be it and Selah! AND WHERE WERE YOU ON THE DAY THE WORLD ENDED? Dharma, it is too late this writing to begin on the “Villains of the S&L Crisis” so we will close for now and hopefully, include it within the next scribing. The cover-up in the official Washington circles has gone on for well over a decade and now the dis- tractions are hiding it most effectively while the RTC steals the rest of your assets--So be it, chelas--it is time for “put up” or “shut up”. In the Santa Barbara Savings debacle alone, you will find it goes all the way past the past presidency of Reagan and right on into the present administration and, although personal in proximity unto you as a group--regarding this current property of my scribe--it is typical and rampant in the network of ALL. I certainly don’t want to miss giving the proper ones credit where due. The plan has worked to perfec- tion to bring your nation down and allow capturing of uncountable prof- its and property unto the money- mongers and greedy treasonists of your wondrously created nation. How could this have come to be? Easily! You were lulled to sleep by all the luxuries and “good life” and you didn’t notice that the trap was closing and that there was not escape exit built into the dungeon. There is one debacle after another built into your future and immediate course and each one will be larger and more extensive (and expensive) than the prior. You are in a DE- PRESSION, and you. have somehow . 8 Vol. IV #8 not noticed even though I have been badgering you endlessly about it. YOU CAN CHANGE IT IF YOU WANT TO; LET US SEE WHO WILL WANT TO! SALU! Hatonn to clear, please. Thank you for your attendance.
